subject: Pilot MAP + hosting needs clarification
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam@finlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Li <rachel.li@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics pilot — follow-up and MAP request

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo today — the model latency and cost numbers looked promising. We discussed a short pilot to evaluate classification + summarization in our claims intake pipeline. Before we get the MAP (mutual action plan) in place, a couple of clarifying items from our side so we scope appropriately: 

- Deployment preference: we want the fastest path to proof — prefer Hosted API if there are no blockers. We may need a Private VPC option later for PHI/data residency.
- Sandbox endpoints: how long until we can get sandbox keys and an isolated endpoint?
- Rate limits: we need guidance for expected rate capacities and how burst vs sustained is handled. Peak QPS will be short bursts from our ingestion windows.
- Security: do you have a short checklist of what you need (SOC2 evidence, encryption, network egress)?

I'll pull some traffic numbers and share them in a follow-up. Can you also send a simple MAP template (timeline + responsibilities)?

Thanks,
Sam Park
Head of AI Integrations, Finlytics

Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics pilot — follow-up and MAP request

Hi Sam — great to meet you today. Quick answers and a short checklist so we can move toward a hosted pilot quickly. See inline and attached.

- Deployment preference: Hosted API is the fastest to stand up — typical sandbox access (<48 hours) and pilot endpoints within ~3 business days once we have the MAP + security intake. If you need Private VPC, that is doable but adds a provisioning lead time (2–4 weeks) and an onboarding rubric. Dedicated capacity is recommended when you need predictable sustained throughput with reserved commit.

- Sandbox/endpoints: We can provision a shared sandbox workspace (dev keys) immediately; isolated sandbox endpoints (per-tenant) require the MAP and a workspace creation ticket.

- Rate limits: For Hosted pilots we set an initial rate cap (tokens/sec and concurrent calls). Typical pilot defaults: 10 QPS / 50 concurrent sessions; we can bump to 100 QPS for short bursts with a soft-burst policy. For accurate guidance, send your traffic profile (avg tokens per request, avg requests/sec, burst duration).

- Security checklist (short): SOC2 report, network egress regions, SSO requirements, KMS/HSM needs, data retention policy, IP allowlist. I've attached our Quickstart checklist which includes required items and contact points.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You share traffic spreadsheet (sample rows ok) and any special compliance constraints (PHI/PCI).
2) We fill and sign a short MAP template (link in my follow-up).
3) Ben will prepare a pilot pricing estimate for Hosted + a note on Dedicated commit ranges.
4) Marissa will schedule a 45-minute technical onboarding session (sandbox keys + sample calls).

Attaching: redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf (quick items), MAP template link.

Happy to jump on a quick follow to lock timeline.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sam Park <sam@finlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Li <rachel.li@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finlytics pilot — follow-up and MAP request

Thanks Irene — helpful. Attaching a simple traffic estimate (two tabs: daily profile + burst windows). High level:

- Avg request size: 350 tokens (input + output)
- Avg sustained throughput expected in pilot: 12 rps (mostly during business hours)
- Burst windows: up to 220 rps for 60–120s during peak ingestion (once per hour)
- Concurrent sessions: up to 45 during peaks

Security: we are SOC2 Type II and can share the report; PHI is in scope for some data flows and we will likely need VPC or strict tenancy controls for production. For the pilot, we can keep data pseudonymized and run on Hosted as long as the sandbox is isolated and logs are retained per our policy.

Attached: finlytics-traffic-estimates.xlsx, security-snapshot.zip

Sam

Subject: Internal: Finlytics pilot — next actions (hosted pilot + VPC path)

Marissa / Ben — quick internal summary and asks so we can move the pilot forward. Customer: Finlytics (Sam Park / Rachel Li). They prefer Hosted for speed but will require Private VPC for production later (PHI). Pilot constraints: short bursts up to 220 rps (60–120s), sustained ~12 rps, avg 350 tokens per request.

Action items:
- Ben: please draft a pilot pricing estimate for Hosted (sandbox + 30-day pilot) and add an optional appendix for Dedicated commit ranges and a private VPC onboarding surcharge. Target: send by EOD next Tue.
- Marissa: schedule the 45-minute technical onboarding (ideally Mon/Tue next week). Include sandbox endpoint provisioning, sample curl requests, and a short walkthrough of rate cap controls and KV/prefix caching tips for the ingestion bursts.
- Ops/Security (I'll loop in via Jira): confirm that the sandbox logs retention and pseudonymization approach meet Finlytics' policy; prepare a secure link for SOC2 evidence.

I'll prepare the MAP draft (using the template link) and share with Sam for signature. We'll aim to provision sandbox keys within 48 hours of MAP execution.

Notes: attach the customer's traffic sheet and security snapshot in the HubSpot record (link below). If we foresee that Hosted can't meet their eventual data residency requirements, flag private VPC early so we can run parallel onboarding.

Thanks — Irene

Attachments referenced: finlytics-traffic-estimates.xlsx, security-snapshot.zip
